text: dsh-wiki 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的本地仓库 Wiki 插件。它注册仓库文档生成技能和 /wiki 命令，并把生成后的站点挂到 DSH 本机服务。用户可以为当前或指定仓库生成带路径与行号引用的分页文档，用命令查看站点或列出已知 Wiki，也能从侧栏面板选择并内嵌阅读。适合希望在开发会话中整理代码库知识、查阅模块说明的用户；生成协议要求文档和站点在本机处理。

dsh-wiki is a local wiki plugin for DSH Web. Its skill and /wiki command generate paged repository documentation with file and line citations. Use /wiki view or list to find built sites, then browse them in the sidebar or a separate window. Generation and site building follow a local workflow.
想给手头的代码仓库生成一份带文件行号出处的本地 Wiki。
能不能在 DSH 里直接浏览已生成的仓库文档？
I want a command to generate and open a browsable wiki for a repository in my DSH session.
dsh-wiki 的功能「生成仓库 Wiki」：在会话中运行 /wiki generate，可为当前工作区或指定路径启动生成技能；技能按仓库结构规划分页内容，要求加入文件路径与行号证据，再构建并自检本地站点。
dsh-wiki 的功能「浏览已生成 Wiki」：侧栏面板从本机索引读取已知 Wiki，用户可选中站点在面板内嵌阅读或新窗口打开；/wiki list 列出站点，/wiki view 打开当前或指定仓库的 Wiki。
@acfufu/dsh-wiki 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 6；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · Introduction：

dsh-wiki

DeepWiki 式本地仓库 Wiki，为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 而做：零上传、零网络、证据优先。
agent 在本地读懂仓库 → 产出带 路径:行号 证据引用的分页 wiki（目录树 + 图表）→ 构建单文件自包含站点，挂在本机 DSH 宿主上直接浏览。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · Introduction：> [!NOTE]
> **代码库的知识不该只活在原作者脑子里，也不该以"把整个仓库传上去"为代价。**
>
> 社区（awesome-dsh-plugin，9100+ 插件）里没有交付"DeepWiki 式"产物的插件：dsh-openwiki 依赖外挂 CLI 且停更、codemap 有引用无正文、archify 只有图。dsh-wiki 把**叙事正文 + 强制机检的证据引用 + 离线图表 + 自包含站点**合成一个 DSH bundle——全程本地，一行数据都不出网。
>
> ```sh
> git clone https://github.com/Acfufu/dsh-wiki && cd dsh-wiki
> "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add "$PWD"
> ```

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ✨ 这是什么：一个标准 DSH 社区插件（`@acfufu/dsh-wiki`），装进任意 web/desktop profile 后给你四样东西：

| 入口 | 形式 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **`dsh-wiki` 技能** | runtime skill | 对话里说「给这个仓库生成 wiki」即接管：盘点 → 配置解析 → 语言判定 → 页面树规划 → 逐页写作 → build + selfcheck |
| **`/wiki` 命令** | slash command | `/wiki generate [路径]`（fork 子代理执行）、`/wiki view`（给出本机站点 URL）、`/wiki list` |
| **📚 侧栏 Wiki 面板** | 左侧栏全局面板 | 左栏新增 📖 入口：点开即列出所有已构建 wiki，选中后站点内嵌在应用里阅读（刷新 / 返回列表 / 新窗口一键切换） |
| **📖 Wiki 按钮** | 会话头部槽位 | 以独立窗口打开本机索引页（不想占用主面板时用） |

生成产物 `<仓库>/.dsh-wiki/`：

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ✨ 这是什么：- `wiki.json` — 唯一事实源（schema `repo-wiki-local/1`，分页 + 内嵌 markdown）
- `pages/<id>.md` — 每页导出副本，便于 diff
- `generation-meta.json` — 生效配置与逐字段 provenance
- `site/index.html` — **单文件自包含站点**：目录树导航、全文搜索（键盘可操作）、深浅双主题、mermaid 离线渲染、内联 SVG 自动净化、窄屏自适应

站点经**零外链机检**（覆盖实体编码、protocol-relative、CSS `url()`/`@import` 等形态）；正文 `` `path:line` `` 引用由 selfcheck 强制机检：文件必须存在、行号必须在界内，越界 = 生成失败。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🚀 安装：前置：DSH Desktop 或 web profile（`dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`）、`python3 ≥ 3.7`（构建器纯标准库，无第三方依赖）。

**路线 A · GUI 插件页**：侧栏「插件」→ 添加插件 → 填本仓库路径（或 `https://github.com/Acfufu/dsh-wiki`）→ 安装 → 启用。

**路线 B · CLI**：

```sh
CLI="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop add github:Acfufu/dsh-wiki
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop list
```
@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🚀 安装：desktop profile 是 `patchReload: live`，装完刷新页面即生效。版本门禁声明覆盖 `^0.1.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` 两条线（与 @jieai/dsh-plugin-vet 同款写法，0.2.2-rc.1 实测通过），无需豁免。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🧭 用法：```sh
/wiki generate            # 为当前工作区生成完整 wiki（fork 子代理跑技能协议）
/wiki generate /path/repo # 指定仓库
/wiki view                # 输出当前仓库站点的本机 URL
/wiki list                # 列出所有已知 wiki

本机路由（桌面宿主回环地址）：

- `/dsh-wiki/` — wiki 索引页（自动汇总已发现的仓库）
- `/dsh-wiki/site?path=<仓库>/.dsh-wiki` — 直接打开某个站点
- `/dsh-wiki/api/status` — JSON 状态

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🧭 用法：**发现机制**：插件从会话事件自动记住工作目录（持久化在 `<profile home>/dsh-wiki/registry.json`），并自动扫描已知目录的**同级目录**——凡含 `<wikiDirName>/site/index.html` 即收录，`import-legacy` 导入的存量 wiki 无需任何配置即可出现在索引；`config.wikiRoots` 可补充额外根目录。

**从 ZCode 迁移**：对话里说「导入 ZCode 的旧 wiki」或 `/repo-wiki` 存量数据（`~/.zcode/v2/repo-wiki/<hash>`）经 `import-legacy` 一键转入——数据格式与 [zcode-repo-wiki](https://github.com/Acfufu/zcode-repo-wiki) 完全兼容。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ⚔️ 与社区同类方案对比：| | dsh-wiki | dsh-openwiki | dsh-plugin-codemap | archify |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 叙事 wiki 正文 | ✅ 分页 + 目录树 | ✅（外挂 CLI） | ❌ | ❌ |
| `path:line` 证据 + 机检 | ✅ 强制 | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |
| 图表（mermaid/SVG 离线渲染） | ✅ | ❌ | 依赖图 | ✅ 仅图 |
| 单文件自包含站点（搜索/双主题） | ✅ 零外链机检 | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| 第二工具链 / 第二密钥 | ❌ 不需要 | ✅ 需要 | ❌ | ❌ |
| 上传仓库内容 | 从不 | 视后端 | 从不 | 云端 |
| 维护状态 | 活跃 | 停更（2026-09） | 活跃 | 上游活跃 |

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🎛️ 配置：插件行 `config`（GUI 插件页可逐行改）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-wiki
  config:
    wikiDirName: .dsh-wiki   # 各仓库内 wiki 目录名
    wikiRoots: []            # 额外扫描的绝对路径数组

生成配置四层合并：内置默认 → `~/.dsh/dsh-wiki/config.json` → `<仓库>/.dsh-wiki/config.json` → `--set k=v`。预设 `compact`/`standard`/`deep`/`legacy`；可调语言、页数、粒度（theme/file/hybrid）、每页字数、图表密度（none/minimal/rich）、引用档位（relaxed/strict）。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🔒 安全与隐私：| 行为 | dsh-wiki |
| --- | --- |
| 上传仓库内容 / Git 历史 | **从不** |
| 网络请求（生成、图表、字体、脚本） | **从不**（构建器零第三方依赖、站点零外链） |
| 读取 `.git` 对象内容 | **从不**（唯一例外：可选 `git log --oneline -15` 摘要） |
| 产物位置 | 仅本地磁盘 |

宿主侧路由安全边界：仅回环 Host 放行 + 目录名必须等于 `wikiDirName` + 只读单文件服务，无遍历面。通用提醒：插件宿主半区跑在宿主进程内，建议配合 `@jieai/dsh-plugin-vet` 自查。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🧪 测试：```sh
python3 tests/test_build_wiki_site.py   # 构建器回归 64 项（注入 PoC、SVG 净化、配置合并、node --check 站点脚本）
node tools/harness-test.mjs             # 宿主半区 25 项（技能注册/命令/路由/信任围栏/子代理路径）
```

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ❓ FAQ：**和 DeepWiki（Cognition）有什么区别？** DeepWiki 托管在云端、把仓库上传给服务；dsh-wiki 用你本地会话里的模型，数据一步不出机器，产物是可双击打开的 HTML。

**支持哪些 DSH 版本？** peer 声明 `^0.1.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`，实测 0.2.2-rc.1（2026-11-04 latest）；未使用任何 0.2.2 破坏性 API（tools.resolve / tools.mode / Session Projection 均避开）。

**headless / tui profile 能用吗？** 技能与 `/wiki view|list` 可用；`/wiki generate` 与本机站点路由依赖 web 桌面宿主（webServer）。

**构建器要装依赖吗？** 不要。纯 Python 3.7+ 标准库，零 pip 安装。
@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 📄 许可：MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。构建器与查看器源自 [zcode-repo-wiki](https://github.com/Acfufu/zcode-repo-wiki)（MIT）。内联 mermaid 运行时含第三方组件，见 `assets/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES`。

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · Introduction：

dsh-wiki

DeepWiki-style local repo wiki for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): zero upload, zero network, evidence first.
The agent reads your repository locally → produces a paged wiki with path:line citations (nav tree + diagrams) → builds a single self-contained HTML site served by your local DSH host.

Install · Usage · Comparison · Privacy · Tests · 简体中文
@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · Introduction：

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · Introduction：> [!NOTE]
> **Codebase knowledge shouldn't live only in the original author's head — and shouldn't cost "upload the whole repo".**
>
> Among 9,100+ community plugins on awesome-dsh-plugin, none delivers a true DeepWiki-shaped artifact: dsh-openwiki wraps an external CLI and is unmaintained; codemap has citations but no prose; archify has diagrams but no wiki text. dsh-wiki combines **narrative pages + machine-checked evidence citations + offline diagrams + a self-contained site** in one DSH bundle — everything local, nothing leaves the machine.
>
> ```sh
> git clone https://github.com/Acfufu/dsh-wiki && cd dsh-wiki
> "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add "$PWD"
> ```
@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ✨ What it is：A standard DSH community plugin (`@acfufu/dsh-wiki`). Once installed into any web/desktop profile it gives you four entries:

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ✨ What it is：| Entry | Shape | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **`dsh-wiki` skill** | runtime skill | Say "generate a wiki for this repo" and the 5-phase protocol takes over: inventory → config resolution → language detection → page-tree planning → per-page writing → build + selfcheck |
| **`/wiki` command** | slash command | `/wiki generate [path]` (runs in a fork subagent), `/wiki view` (prints the local site URL), `/wiki list` |
| **📚 Sidebar Wiki panel** | left sidebar global panel | A new 📖 row in the sidebar: click to list every built wiki, pick one and the site is read right inside the app (refresh / back to list / pop-out) |
| **📖 Wiki button** | session-header slot | Opens the local index page in a standalone window (when you don't want to leave the conversation) |

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ✨ What it is：Artifacts land in `<repo>/.dsh-wiki/`:

- `wiki.json` — single source of truth (schema `repo-wiki-local/1`, paged, inline markdown)
- `pages/<id>.md` — per-page export for diffing
- `generation-meta.json` — resolved config with per-field provenance
- `site/index.html` — **single-file self-contained site**: nav tree, full-text search (keyboard operable), light/dark themes, offline mermaid rendering, sanitized inline SVG, mobile responsive

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ✨ What it is：The site passes a **zero-external-link machine check** (entity encoding, protocol-relative URLs, CSS `url()`/`@import` forms covered); every `` `path:line` `` citation is machine-verified: the file must exist and the line number must be in range — out of range = generation failure.

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🚀 Install：Prereqs: a DSH Desktop / web profile (`dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`), `python3 ≥ 3.7` (pure-stdlib builder, no third-party deps).

**Route A · GUI plugin page**: sidebar "Plugins" → Add → paste this repo path (or `https://github.com/Acfufu/dsh-wiki`) → Install → Enable.

**Route B · CLI**:

```sh
CLI="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop add github:Acfufu/dsh-wiki
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop list
```

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🚀 Install：The desktop profile runs `patchReload: live` — refresh and it's live. Peer ranges `^0.1.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` pass the 0.2.2-rc.1 version gate (same style as @jieai/dsh-plugin-vet), no exemptions needed.

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🧭 Usage：```sh
/wiki generate            # full wiki for the current workspace (fork subagent)
/wiki generate /path/repo # explicit repo
/wiki view                # print the local site URL
/wiki list                # list known wikis

Local routes (loopback on the desktop host):

- `/dsh-wiki/` — wiki index (auto-aggregates discovered repos)
- `/dsh-wiki/site?path=<repo>/.dsh-wiki` — open one site directly
- `/dsh-wiki/api/status` — JSON status

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🧭 Usage：**Discovery**: session workspaces are remembered automatically (persisted to `<profile home>/dsh-wiki/registry.json`), and **sibling directories** of known roots are scanned too — any dir containing `<wikiDirName>/site/index.html` is picked up, so wikis imported via `import-legacy` show up in the index with zero config; `config.wikiRoots` adds extra roots.

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🧭 Usage：**Migrating from ZCode**: say "import the legacy wiki" — `import-legacy` converts [zcode-repo-wiki](https://github.com/Acfufu/zcode-repo-wiki) data (`~/.zcode/v2/repo-wiki/<hash>`) in one step; the `wiki.json` schema is fully compatible.

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ⚔️ vs Community Alternatives：| | dsh-wiki | dsh-openwiki | dsh-plugin-codemap | archify |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Narrative wiki prose | ✅ paged + nav tree | ✅ (external CLI) | ❌ | ❌ |
| `path:line` citations + machine check | ✅ enforced | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Diagrams (offline mermaid/SVG) | ✅ | ❌ | dep graph only | ✅ diagrams only |
| Single-file self-contained site (search/themes) | ✅ zero-external-link checked | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Second toolchain / second API key | ❌ none | ✅ required | ❌ | ❌ |
| Uploads repo content | never | backend-dependent | never | cloud |
| Maintenance | active | stale (2026-09) | active | upstream active |

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🎛️ Configuration：Plugin row `config` (editable per-line in the GUI plugin page):

```yaml
- id: dsh-wiki
  config:
    wikiDirName: .dsh-wiki   # wiki dir name inside each repo
    wikiRoots: []            # extra absolute scan roots

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🎛️ Configuration：Generation config merges four layers: builtin defaults → `~/.dsh/dsh-wiki/config.json` → `<repo>/.dsh-wiki/config.json` → `--set k=v`. Presets `compact`/`standard`/`deep`/`legacy`; tunables cover language, page count, granularity (theme/file/hybrid), words per page, diagram density (none/minimal/rich), citation mode (relaxed/strict).

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🔒 Security & Privacy：| Behavior | dsh-wiki |
| --- | --- |
| Uploads repo content / Git history | **never** |
| Network requests (generation, diagrams, fonts, scripts) | **never** (zero-dep builder, zero-external-link site) |
| Reads `.git` object contents | **never** (sole exception: optional `git log --oneline -15` summary) |
| Artifact location | local disk only |

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🔒 Security & Privacy：Host-side route fence: loopback Host check + directory basename must equal `wikiDirName` + read-only single-file serving, no traversal surface. General reminder: the plugin host half runs inside the host process — pair with `@jieai/dsh-plugin-vet` if you audit plugins.

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · 🧪 Tests：```sh
python3 tests/test_build_wiki_site.py   # 64 builder regression checks (injection PoCs, SVG sanitizing, config merge, node --check on site scripts)
node tools/harness-test.mjs             # 25 host-half checks (skill registration / commands / routes / trust fence / subagent paths)
```

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ❓ FAQ：**How is this different from DeepWiki (Cognition)?** DeepWiki is a hosted service — the repo leaves your machine. dsh-wiki uses the model in your local session; nothing leaves the machine and the artifact is an HTML file you can double-click.

**Which DSH versions?** Peers declare `^0.1.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`; verified on 0.2.2-rc.1 (2026-11-04 latest). No 0.2.2-breaking APIs used (tools.resolve / tools.mode / Session Projection all avoided).

@acfufu/dsh-wiki README · ❓ FAQ：**headless / tui profiles?** The skill and `/wiki view|list` work; `/wiki generate` and the local site routes need the web/desktop host (webServer).

**Does the builder need dependencies?** No. Pure Python 3.7+ stdlib, zero pip installs.
